reason: Batch 003 source audit removed unsupported parking-structure geometry locators. PD 1096 Rule VII supports slot/loading sizes and plan indication; BP 344 supports accessible parking details. Rule XIX, Section 803, and Section 904 are not parking geometry locators.

proposed.text: What plan-checking requirement for parking slots is source-backed by the checked PD 1096 Rule VII text?

options.text: Parking aisles must use a 6.1 m module in all cases
Parking slots must be drawn to scale and the total number indicated on the plans
Structural columns must always be spaced at 15 m

proposed.rationale: The checked PD 1096 text requires parking slots to be drawn to scale with the total number indicated on the plans.
proposed.explanation: The old structural-module question relied on unsupported geometry standards.
proposed.code_citation: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule VII parking slot requirements
